name: Ikuta Katsumi
source:
Superintendent of the National Police Agency and Chief of 1st Division. A talented, no-nonsense policeman, he rises to the rank of Superintendent at a very young age. Very strict with Ruka, but also trusts him (albeit reluctantly) when it comes to investigative work.

Despite his looks and attitude, he's able to crack a joke at the protagonist's expense.
